Corporate

Board & Management

An executive and advisory team combining decades of deepwater exploration experience, major operator leadership, and capital markets discipline.

Executive Management

Directing day-to-day operations, joint-venture partner alignment with TotalEnergies, and technical work programmes.

Craig Steinke

Chief Executive Officer & Director

Craig Steinke is the Chief Executive Officer and a Director of BluEnergies Ltd. A co-founder of the company, he has more than 30 years of international experience identifying, evaluating, structuring, and financing natural resource and energy exploration ventures across emerging and frontier basins worldwide. Under his leadership, BluEnergies identified and captured the Harper Basin deepwater play and negotiated the farm-in partnership with TotalEnergies.

Enzo Insalaco

Executive Vice-President and General Counsel

Executive Vice-President and General Counsel of BluEnergies Ltd. Brings extensive international legal, regulatory, and commercial transaction experience within the upstream oil and gas sector across Africa and global frontier jurisdictions. [CONTENT NEEDED: additional biographical details]

Sergio Laura

Vice President of Exploration

Sergio Laura is a petroleum geologist with over 40 years of international hydrocarbon exploration and reservoir geology experience. Formerly with major international operators including Eni/Agip, he has led technical evaluations, seismic interpretation programmes, and exploration campaigns across West Africa, North Africa, and the Mediterranean.

Board of Directors

Providing independent governance, risk management oversight, and strategic guidance across our exploration portfolio.

Carol Law

Independent Director

Carol Law brings over 40 years of technical, managerial, and commercial leadership in the international petroleum exploration industry. She previously held senior exploration and asset management positions with major independent and international oil companies including Amoco, BP, and Anadarko Petroleum Corporation.

Cyrus Driver

Independent Director & Audit Committee Chair

Cyrus Driver is a Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA, CA) and retired partner of Davidson & Company LLP, Chartered Professional Accountants, Vancouver, BC. He has over 30 years of public accounting and financial auditing experience advising TSX and TSX Venture Exchange listed exploration and mining issuers on corporate governance, audit standards, and regulatory compliance.

The majority of the Board of Directors of BluEnergies Ltd. are independent under Canadian securities regulations.Corporate governance policies →
